original_description: Plan immersive 3D websites from a brief, reference site, or existing project. Map distinct scenes for each page, choose a visual direction, plan camera motion and interactions, and define practical architecture. Includes studio and portfolio concepts, cinematic home and interior journeys, truthful live-preview and data guidance, responsive accessibility, complete 2D fallbacks, and route-by-route visual QA. This skills-only plugin provides instructions and prompts; it does not host, fetch, monitor, or deploy a website by itself.
summary_ja: 3Dウェブサイトの場面・動き・構成・表示確認を計画。
limitations: スキルのみのプラグインであり、単体ではサイトのホスティング、取得、監視、デプロイを行わないと説明。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
